integrity: Universal congruence proof with independent finite computation; no formal or external mathematical certification. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: For G=C_{p^m} direct-sum C_p and m>=4 only; separate first three fixed-point layers and all ordered-pair orbit counts are covered in earlier literature. Does not treat C_{p^a} direct-sum C_{p^b} with a>=2. Possible unlocated stronger multiplicity theorem. Boundary m=3 entirely published.
title: Complete automorphism fixed-point multiplicities for \(C_p\oplus C_{p^m}\) beyond the small-exponent tables
